rationale: Y has a more distinctive hero (video-grid class UI plus a tilted handwritten progress report with a stamp), an italic accent in the headline, a richer palette with yellow on navy, and varied illustrated feature cards with a language-specific offer. X is competent, but its warm-cream and terracotta layout with a chat card reads more like a standard template. Its feature illustrations are clipped or plain, and its hero overlay and spacing are less resolved.
